description: Preset parameter reads / writes through the single write choke point, and the runtime (session) parameters.

commands.name: param.get
commands.title: Read a parameter
commands.description: Reads preset parameters. parameter: string | mode | gauss | gauss_flat | gauss_full | hammer | excitation | feedin | feedback | feedin_mask | feedback_mask | sound_channel | sound_channel_mask | string_sound_channel. key_no: a mode number for `mode`; a PITCH number for every other parameter (feedin / feedback / masks rows are indexed by mode); 'all' or 'from<a>to<b>' for ranges.

key_no.description: Mode number (mode) or pitch number (all other domains); 'all'; 'from<a>to<b>'

commands.name: param.set
commands.title: Write a parameter
commands.description: Writes preset parameters through the choke point (read-only guard, state_changed broadcast, one undo step). values has the same structure the matching param.get returns. Key space as param.get: feedin / feedback / masks / sound_channel are keyed by PITCH (output pitches >= 128 only for feedback / feedback_mask).

key_no.description: Mode number (mode) or pitch number (all other domains); 'all'; 'from<a>to<b>'

values.description: Payload in the GET shape of the same parameter

commands.name: runtime.get
commands.title: Read the runtime parameters
commands.description: Live session parameters: volume_level (slider 0-127), feedback, volume_center, volume_range, gate.

commands.name: runtime.set
commands.title: Set the runtime parameters
commands.description: volume: slider level 0-127 MIDI. feedback: 0 = silence, 1-127 MIDI-mapped (64 = 1.0), other values a direct coefficient. feedback_coeff: direct effective coefficient (bypasses the mapping). store_feedback_coeff: the per-preset stored baseline (in memory until save).

commands.name: param.mute_modes
commands.title: Mute / unmute / solo a mode range
commands.description: Mutes, unmutes or solos a set of MODES on a set of keys through the deck masks (feedin_mask / feedback_mask), writing the whole num_modes rows for you in one undo step. modes: 'all' | 'from<a>to<b>' | n | [n, ...] (mode indices). pitches: piano keys, default 'all' (never the output pitches 128+). side: feedin | feedback | both (default). action: mute | unmute | solo (solo = the named modes on, every other mode off). 'Mute all modes except 0 and 1' = {modes: [0, 1], action: 'solo'}. The raw deck values are never touched.

modes.description: Mode indices: 'all', 'from<a>to<b>', n or a list

pitches.description: Piano keys: 'all' (default), 'from<a>to<b>', n or a list

commands.name: param.mute_channels
commands.title: Mute / unmute / solo output channels
commands.description: Mutes, unmutes or solos OUTPUT (sound) channels with the mask that really mutes them for the loaded preset: listen_to_modes 0 (strings axis) -> the feedback_mask row of output pitch 128+ch; listen_to_modes 1 (modes axis) -> column ch of sound_channel_mask on every piano key. channels: 'all' | n | [n, ...] (0-based). action: mute | unmute | solo (solo = only the named channels on). A channel row is written whole (unmute / solo clear its per-mode mutes). The result names the axis / mask used and channels_on. 'Channel 0 only' = {channels: [0], action: 'solo'}; 'unmute all' = {channels: 'all', action: 'unmute'}.

channels.description: 0-based channel numbers: 'all', n or a list

commands.name: param.inventory
commands.title: Read the parameter inventory
commands.description: The parameter glossary (schemas/params): every parameter domain with its key space, row shape, stored vs effective, the command that reads / writes it and the doc anchor; with {domain} one domain with every field (units, range, class stored / derived / read-only, one-line meaning, doc anchor). UNKNOWN = the docs do not state it: never present it as known, measure it.

domain.description: one domain, e.g. mode, string, hammer, feedin_mask, runtime, load_settings; omit for the overview
